body: Københavns Kommune åbner i næste uge en ny cykelsti langs Kalvebod Brygge. Stien skal binde Islands Brygge sammen med centrum og fjerne den sidste smalle passage, hvor lastbiler og cyklister i dag deler asfalt. Teknik- og miljøforvaltningen oplyser, at anlægsarbejdet har kostet 18 millioner kroner, og at broen over havneløbet får separat belysning. Flere beboere har i høringssvar peget på, at stien stadig krydser en travl indkørsel til et P-hus. Forvaltningen svarer, at der kommer hævede belægninger og nedsat hastighed for biler. Borgmesteren kalder projektet et led i målet om, at halvdelen af alle ture i indre by skal ske på cykel inden 2030. Åbningen er planlagt til torsdag morgen, så pendlerne kan bruge stien allerede samme dag.
translated: Copenhagen Municipality will open a new cycle track along Kalvebod Brygge next week. The path is meant to connect Islands Brygge with the city centre and remove the last narrow stretch where lorries and cyclists currently share the asphalt. The technical and environmental department says the works cost 18 million kroner and that the bridge over the harbour channel will have separate lighting. Several residents noted in consultation replies that the path still crosses a busy car-park entrance. The department replies that raised paving and a lower speed limit for cars are coming. The mayor calls the project part of the goal that half of all trips in the inner city should be by bike by 2030. Opening is planned for Thursday morning so commuters can use the path the same day.
summary: Copenhagen will open an 18 million kroner cycle track along Kalvebod Brygge on Thursday, aiming to separate bikes from lorries and support a 2030 inner-city cycling goal. Officials promise raised paving where the path crosses a car-park entrance.

body: Et kraftigt lavtryk rammer Vestjylland onsdag aften med kastevinde op til 28 meter i sekundet. DMI har udsendt varsel i kategori 2 for kysten mellem Blåvand og Thyborøn. Kommunerne fraråder unødvendig kørsel på de små dæmningsveje, og flere færger mellem de små øer indstilles fra klokken 16. Beredskabet i Ringkøbing-Skjern har allerede flyttet sandsække op til de lavtliggende sommerhusområder ved Stadil Fjord. El-selskabet forventer lokale afbrydelser, hvis salte skyer driver ind over luftledningerne. Foreningen af campingpladser beder gæster om at slå markiser ned og tømme vandbeholdere. Vinden topper efter midnat og løjer af torsdag formiddag, men høje bølger kan fortsætte i Vesterhavet resten af dagen.
translated: A strong low-pressure system will hit West Jutland on Wednesday evening with gusts of up to 28 metres per second. DMI has issued a category 2 warning for the coast between Blåvand and Thyborøn. Municipalities advise against unnecessary driving on the small dike roads, and several ferries between the small islands will be suspended from 16:00. The emergency service in Ringkøbing-Skjern has already moved sandbags up to the low-lying holiday-house areas by Stadil Fjord. The power company expects local outages if salty clouds drift over the overhead lines. The camping-site association asks guests to take down awnings and empty water tanks. The wind peaks after midnight and eases Thursday morning, but high waves may continue in the North Sea for the rest of the day.
summary: West Jutland faces a category 2 wind warning on Wednesday night with gusts up to 28 m/s, ferry suspensions from 16:00, and possible power cuts. Sandbags are already in place around Stadil Fjord; the wind should ease Thursday morning.

body: Aarhus Festuge slår i år dørene op med et program, der bevidst blander byens havn, de gamle industrihaller på Godsbanen og de små scener i Latinerkvarteret. Festivalledelsen lover færre sponsorbannere på Store Torv og flere gratis koncerter i byrummet, efter sidste års kritik af, at midtbyen føltes afspærret. Årets tema hedder »Naboer« og handler ifølge kuratorerne om, hvordan midlertidige fællesskaber opstår mellem mennesker, der ellers kun mødes i supermarkedet. Blandt de bekræftede navne er en færøsk korgruppe, et kollektiv af slam-poeter fra Gellerup og en natlig cykeloptakt, hvor publikum selv medbringer lygter. Museerne holder åbent til midnat tre aftener i træk, og Aarhus Universitet stiller en række tomme auditorier til rådighed for samtalesaloner. Handlende i Vestergade er delt: nogle håber på omsætning sent om aftenen, andre frygter, at gågaden igen bliver en flaskehals. Kommunen indsætter ekstra affaldshold og mobile toiletter ved åen. Festugen varer ti dage, og det samlede offentlige tilskud er uændret i forhold til sidste år, selv om antallet af scener stiger. Billetter til de store haller kommer i salg mandag; de åbne byrumsarrangementer kræver ingen forudbestilling.
translated: Aarhus Festival opens this year with a programme that deliberately mixes the harbour, the old industrial halls at Godsbanen and the small stages in the Latin Quarter. Organisers promise fewer sponsor banners on Store Torv and more free concerts in public space, after last year's criticism that the centre felt fenced off. This year's theme is Neighbours and is, according to the curators, about how temporary communities form between people who otherwise only meet in the supermarket. Confirmed names include a Faroese choir, a collective of slam poets from Gellerup and a night-time bike prelude where the audience brings its own lights. Museums stay open until midnight three evenings in a row, and Aarhus University is offering empty lecture halls for conversation salons. Shopkeepers in Vestergade are split: some hope for late-evening trade, others fear the pedestrian street will again become a bottleneck. The municipality will add extra waste crews and mobile toilets by the river. The festival lasts ten days, and the total public subsidy is unchanged from last year even though the number of stages is rising. Tickets for the large halls go on sale Monday; open-space events need no booking.
summary: Aarhus Festival returns for ten days under the theme Neighbours, with more free city-space concerts and fewer banners after last year's complaints. Hall tickets go on sale Monday; public-space events are free, and the city subsidy is unchanged.

body: Færgen mellem Kalundborg og Aarhus sejlede onsdag med over en times forsinkelse, efter at en hydraulikfejl standsede bovporten i Kalundborg. Rederiet oplyser, at teknikere skiftede en pakning, mens omkring 200 personbiler og 18 lastbiler ventede i opmarchbanerne. En talsmand understreger, at der aldrig var risiko for passagererne, men at intern procedure kræver dobbeltcheck, når porten har været i fejlmode. Flere lastbilchauffører mistede deres slot i Aarhus Havn og måtte omlægge leverancer til torsdag. Passagerer med togforbindelse videre mod Aalborg fik tilbudt kaffe og en voucher til en senere tur. Driften var normal igen på aftenafgangen, og rederiet forventer ikke flere indstillinger. Kystdirektoratet var ikke involveret; hændelsen var rent teknisk.
translated: The ferry between Kalundborg and Aarhus sailed on Wednesday with more than an hour's delay after a hydraulic fault stopped the bow door in Kalundborg. The operator says technicians replaced a seal while about 200 cars and 18 lorries waited in the marshalling lanes. A spokesperson stresses there was never a risk to passengers, but internal procedure requires a double check when the door has been in fault mode. Several lorry drivers lost their slot in Aarhus Harbour and had to move deliveries to Thursday. Passengers with onward trains toward Aalborg were offered coffee and a voucher for a later crossing. Operations were normal again on the evening departure, and the operator does not expect further cancellations. The coastal authority was not involved; the incident was purely technical.
summary: A hydraulic fault on the Kalundborg–Aarhus ferry delayed Wednesday's sailing by more than an hour while a bow-door seal was replaced. Evening sailings resumed; the operator expects no further cancellations.

body: Byrådet i Odense vedtog tirsdag aften et budgetforlig, der løfter folkeskolernes to-voksenordning med 14 millioner kroner og samtidig udskyder renoveringen af tre svømmehaller. Forligspartierne kalder det et kompromis mellem børneområdet og anlæg. Oppositionen stemte imod, fordi den mente, at svømmehallerne allerede har ventelister, og at udskydelsen rammer foreningerne hårdest. Borgmesteren pegede på, at kommunen stadig holder skatten i ro, og at anlægsloftet fra staten ikke giver plads til begge ønsker i samme år. Lærernes kredsformand kaldte løftet om to voksne i indskolingen »et første skridt«, men efterlyste en plan for mellemtrinnet. Budgettet træder i kraft 1. januar. De berørte haller får midlertidigt længere åbningstid om morgenen, så klubberne kan rykke træningstider.
translated: Odense city council adopted a budget deal on Tuesday evening that adds 14 million kroner to the two-adult scheme in municipal schools and postpones renovation of three swimming halls. The coalition calls it a compromise between children and capital works. The opposition voted no because it argued the halls already have waiting lists and that the delay hits sports clubs hardest. The mayor pointed out that the municipality is still keeping the tax rate unchanged and that the state cap on capital spending does not leave room for both wishes in the same year. The teachers' local chair called the promise of two adults in the early years a first step but asked for a plan for the middle years. The budget takes effect on 1 January. The affected halls will temporarily open earlier in the morning so clubs can shift training times.
summary: Odense will spend 14 million kroner on two adults in early-year classrooms and delay three swimming-hall renovations in a budget that keeps the tax rate unchanged. Clubs get earlier morning pool hours as a stopgap.

body: Når man kører ad den smalle kommunevej mellem de to landsbyer, der ellers mest er kendt for deres andelsmejeri og en årlig egnsfest, og man samtidig forsøger at holde øje med de landbrugsmaskiner, der i høstsæsonen svinger ud fra markvejene uden at blinke, de løse hunde ved de første huse, den blændende vestsol over det flade land og de skolebørn, der stiger af den eneste bus klokken 14.10 og går med ryggen til trafikken, fordi fortovet for længst er endt i en grusstripe, så forstår man bedre, hvorfor borgergruppen i tre år har samlet underskrifter for en hævet cykelsti, en lavere hastighedsgrænse og i det mindste en lysregulering ved mejerikrydset, selv om kommunens trafikafdeling igen og igen har svaret, at ulykkestallene endnu ikke er høje nok til, at projektet kan komme med i den fireårige anlægsplan, og at man i stedet vil stille en fartviser op og male nye spærreflader, som ifølge beboerne allerede er slidt af efter én vinter med salt og traktorhjul.
translated: When you drive the narrow municipal road between the two villages, otherwise known mainly for their cooperative dairy and an annual local fete, and you try at the same time to watch for farm machines that swing out from field tracks in harvest season without signalling, the loose dogs by the first houses, the blinding western sun over the flat land and the schoolchildren who leave the only bus at 14:10 and walk with their backs to the traffic because the pavement has long since become a gravel strip, you understand better why the residents' group has spent three years collecting signatures for a raised cycle track, a lower speed limit and at least a set of lights at the dairy junction, even though the municipal traffic office has answered again and again that the accident figures are not yet high enough for the project to enter the four-year capital plan, and that a speed-display sign and new painted hatched areas will be installed instead, which residents say were already worn away after one winter of salt and tractor wheels.
summary: Residents along a narrow Jutland municipal road have collected signatures for three years for a cycle track and lights, but the council says accident figures are too low and offers only a speed sign and fresh paint.
